title: Giant Warehouse
content: Since I was a small child, I have had really vivid dreams set in a large, multi story warehouse. It's made of brick, which is painted black. Some of the upper floors windows are boarded up and some aren't, and those that aren't usually have a light behind them. Inside it's usually pretty dimly lit, with flickering lights in places. It also has elevators, but they're the old kind with the accordion doors. Sometimes it's a performance space (I'm into immersive theater and work as a haunt actor IRL so this isn't that shocking), and sometimes it's just a massive mess of hallways and shelving (which is often full of boxes). One odd thing that really stands out is that there's an area that has flowing water, with a metal grate style bridge crossing it. Has anyone else seen anything similar?
